business_problem: Georgia Tech and its partners needed a way to improve predictive maintenance, energy monitoring and workforce coordination across community infrastructure projects where fragmented systems limited resilience and operational efficiency.
solution_summary: Working with Avid Solutions, ZNAPZ and IBM, Georgia Tech helped shape a smart-infrastructure program that joined asset management, automation and field operations into one coordinated environment. The implementation centered on IBM Maximo Application Suite for asset management and IBM watsonx Orchestrate for workflow automation. Site preparation, system integration, sensor onboarding and drone deployment were staged so the solution could monitor solar panels, irrigation systems and drone assets using real-time sensor data. Maximo extended condition-based monitoring beyond traditional facilities, while watsonx Orchestrate handled smart workflows that reduced manual field response effort. The broader design also connected clean-energy monitoring and agricultural automation, giving community stakeholders a platform for lowering peak-load costs, reducing water waste and scaling resilient operations across counties.

solution_components.name: IBM Maximo Application Suite
solution_components.role: Monitors infrastructure assets such as solar panels, irrigation systems and drone equipment using condition-based maintenance workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Automates field and workforce workflows so infrastructure issues can be coordinated and resolved faster.

data_flow: Sensor and drone data from community infrastructure assets feeds IBM Maximo Application Suite for condition-based monitoring, and the resulting events trigger watsonx Orchestrate workflows that coordinate field response, energy actions and operational follow-up.
business_outcome: The initiative cut downtime and response effort while creating a reusable model for community resilience projects that combine asset monitoring, energy optimization and workforce coordination.
